ignore-pain-health-change-stock.scope: Stock activation from the level-99 diagnostic sends 30 s reuse. The fixed 10 HP sample fires when health is set down or up and stops on expiry. Native PacketLog e082af3518af lines 2360 and 2523 show the +5 direct melee and ballistic resistance add and removal. The server also dispatches natural HP regeneration through the same health-change path. The original retail regen dispatch remains unverified.

awakened-legacy-passive-stats-stock.scope: Stock Bonuses loses Combat Tactics +200 and Viral Defense goes 247 to 47 on unload. Reload restores both. Native PacketLog e082af3518af lines 176, 556 and 734 show +200 records for stats 163 and 183 at entry, unload and reload.
